# NCI FM

> > Manitoba's Indigenous country music radio station serving 80% of the province through 56 FM transmitters and community broadcasting since 1971.

NCI FM is a Indigenous-operated radio network based in Winnipeg, Manitoba, operated by Native Communications Inc. The station combines country music programming with community engagement through bingo games, cultural events, and extensive coverage across rural and urban Manitoba.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous broadcasting
- Manitoba radio network
